title: Public Charging Cable
scenario: A charging kiosk offers free cables but requires installing a profile first.

answers.A: Install the profile so the free cable will work.
answers.B: Use your own cable and a power bank or plain charging socket.
answers.C: Install it temporarily and remove it after charging.
answers.D: Decline the profile and charge later through a trusted accessory.

explanation: A device profile can change settings or grant control. Free charging is not worth installing unknown software while travelling.
proTip: A cable should deliver power, not demand administrator access.
